resources.title: Excalidraw — Collaborative whiteboarding made easy
resources.description: Excalidraw is a virtual collaborative whiteboard tool that lets you easily sketch diagrams that have a hand-drawn feel to them.

resources.name: Gauge UI
resources.title: Gauge UI — composable gauge components for React
resources.description: Composable SVG gauge primitives for React — build speedometers, dials, meters and clocks from arcs, ticks, zones and needles. Distributed as a shadcn registry, so the source lands in your project and you own it.
